section_summary.extract_value: This section contains the references cited in the Iannantuono and Tylka (2012) journal article, along with Figure 1 showing a theoretical model. Figure 1 illustrates hypothesized paths between caregiver eating messages, adult attachment, perfectionism dimensions (discrepancy, high standards, order), body appreciation, depressive symptoms, and intuitive eating, with directional indicators (+ for positive, − for negative relationships). The references support various constructs in the model, including body appreciation assessment, attachment theory, perfectionism, and eating behaviors.

Asset Caption.extract_value: Figure 1. Paths represented in the hypothesized model illustrating the connections between caregiver eating messages, adult attachment, discrepancy (maladaptive) perfectionism, high standards and order (adaptive) perfectionism, depression, body appreciation, and intuitive eating. The proposed direction (positive = +, negative = −) of each hypothesized path is also specified.
Asset Caption.evidence_source: The caption appears directly below the theoretical model diagram on page 230 of the journal article.
